runs.text: The designer thanks the weavers of Barpali.

Barpali sits on the western edge of the Bargarh district, where the Mahanadi bends north. Nearly every household in the village keeps a pit loom, and the tie-and-dye of the warp and weft is done by the family before a single pick is thrown.
To develop contemporary products from the tie-and-dye tradition.
